lines.text: God says to take a young bull, two rams without blemish, and unleavened bread in a basket.
Aaron and his sons are washed with water, and Aaron is clothed and anointed with oil on his head.
The bull is slaughtered, its flesh is burned outside the camp, and God calls it a peace offering.
God says He will meet the Israelites at the tent, consecrate it by His glory, and dwell among them.
